external_and_optional_checks.reason: Sanitizer targets are separate existing project checks; this portable gate does not require sanitizer runtime support. Retain earlier project instrumentation evidence separately.
AArch64 toolchain, QEMU execution and remote GDB are outside this offline native gate. Earlier project cross/emulator evidence remains separate.
Full Buildroot image/toolchain build and full-system guest boot require external sources and target tools.
Kernel compilation, module linking/loading and GPIO board tests require matching external kernel/guest/board environments. No module is loaded by this runner.
Yocto metadata/image/SDK builds and guest deployment require the external pinned checkout and its dependencies.
FreeRTOS POSIX and MCU builds require the pinned downloaded RTOS/toolchain; this runner does not download them or require an existing checkout.
Kernel-driver execution and physical sensor/bus behavior are not established by Python conversion tests.
Privileged tracing and performance experiments are not run; existing test-suite timings are functional observations only.
Flash partitions, bootloader trust, physical power loss and a hardware secure-boot chain are not exercised by the host simulator.
RTOS link hardware, physical robot/sensors, image deployment and optional AI experiments remain separate from the existing host suites.
